This is a greedy simplifier that may produce path with large jumps that are not free (since they only add when the direct segment from last kept point to current point is blocked). But they never add the final point if blocked, they always add raw_path[-1] after loop. This could create a segment from simplified[-1] (maybe far) to raw_path[-1] that might be blocked, but they don't check. However validation will reject if any segment blocked; but validation succeeded (min_gap 0.27). So path is free.

In this case fallback target is ahead_s point, but connector_free from robot pose to that point failed (maybe because robot is near obstacle). So map_stop triggers.
